title: Library of the Citadel knowledge item
description: Portable knowledge-item record for Library of the Citadel (a distinct project from Atom-KB's separate Library). The $id and schema_version are stable identifiers and are deliberately unchanged by the naming decision. Deliberately readable without any Library of the Citadel presentation code. Only the JSON Schema subset listed in docs/content-schema.md is interpreted by src/schema-validate.mjs; keep new constraints inside that subset or add them as a cross-record rule in src/rules.mjs.

item_id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused, never renumbered when records are reordered or superseded.

record_class.description: fixture = authored to demonstrate the schema and the presentation framework; sourced = derived from identified sources and eligible for publication review; practical-note = original everyday cooking notes written for this repository, citing nothing because they claim nothing, and not a demonstration record either. Each class has its own honesty gate in src/rules.mjs.

publication_ready.description: Must be false for record_class fixture and for record_class practical-note (enforced in src/rules.mjs).

record_notice.description: Human-readable honesty banner rendered on every view of this record.

region.description: Region and cuisine labels are presentation/filter facets, not attribution claims. label_basis records how much weight the label carries.

label_basis.description: fixture-illustrative = a label invented for a demonstration record; source-attributed = the cited source names this region or cuisine itself; editorial-facet = this project assigned the label as a browsing facet and no source makes such a claim. An original practical note has no source to attribute, so editorial-facet is the only honest basis for it.

variants.description: Regional variants stay side by side. The framework never collapses them into one supposedly definitive version.

sources.description: Identified source pointers. Empty is legal and expected for fixtures; src/rules.mjs requires at least one entry for record_class sourced. Placeholder or invented URLs are never permitted.

source_state.description: Two of these values describe a record with no sources at all, and they are not interchangeable. none-fixture-authored: the text was written for this repository to exercise the schema. none-authored-here: the text is an original practical note written for this repository, making no claim that needs a citation. src/rules.mjs ties each value to its record_class so neither can be borrowed by the other.

reviewed_at.description: Retrieval date for sourced records; authoring/review date for fixtures.

change_history.description: Newest first. supersedes names the record_version this entry replaced, or null for the initial entry.

images.description: Must stay empty unless image_rights_review_state is cleared (enforced in src/rules.mjs).
